name: Resinheart Sealant
description: A small jar of refined Resinheart Pine resin — the Feywood's canonical waterproofing and wood-sealing compound, also used for incense and as a light adhesive.
narrative_effects: Seals leather, wood, and textile against moisture for sustained periods.
A minor Vaelmere trade export; realm travelers with Feywood connections often keep a jar for field use.
